summary: PASS. Verified the URL-reset regression fix. Frontend web preview loads cleanly at both mobile (390x844) and tablet (1280x800) viewports. All 36 API calls captured went to https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host/api/* with ZERO calls to the wrong preview backend. Live data confirmed: Somchai, Rahul HandCarrier, Lalit party names; ₹21,350 will-give and ฿48,780 will-get totals; shipments CN-1005, CN-1004, CN-1003, CN-1002. Bottom tab navigation (Overview / Shipments / Ledger / Parties / More) functional — endpoints /api/dashboard/stats, /api/dashboard/warehouse, /api/dashboard/ledger-summary, /api/shipments, /api/ledger/entries, /api/parties all hit correctly. No red-screen, no page errors, no 'Failed to fetch' errors. Only benign React Native Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents).

ui_bugs.issue: Displays 'Undefined Bags' where a bag count should be — likely null/undefined bags field from backend not defaulted in UI. Not in scope of current bug fix but worth noting.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings emitted at runtime: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: None for this bug fix — backend URL pin is working. Optional: address the 'Undefined Bags' text on CN-1002 shipment card. Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' props to 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api/client.ts defensive fallback is correct: envUrl guard rejects any 'preview.emergentagent.com' host and falls back to LIVE_BACKEND constant. This is exactly the right hardening for the described regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live backend is https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host. Frontend preview is https://logistics-ai-hub-18.preview.emergentagent.com. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env is the source of truth; if it's ever reset to the preview URL, the defensive fallback in /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts (LIVE_BACKEND constant + envUrl.includes('preview.emergentagent.com') guard) still routes traffic correctly. Verified by inspecting page.on('request') — all /api hits went to logistics-hub-1349.
rca_of_issue: User's Samsung Tab S11 error 'java.io.IOException: Failed to download remote update' is an Expo Go client-side bundle download timeout unrelated to backend URL. Cannot be reproduced in web preview. The associated backend-URL-reset regression (env var reverted to preview host which returns 404 on /api/*) has been mitigated in two layers: (1) restored EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env, (2) hard-coded LIVE_BACKEND fallback in api/client.ts. Web preview verification confirms both layers are active — 36 /api requests all correctly reached logistics-hub-1349.
